dialogues.speaker: Timothy
dialogues.text: That's right. Want one? Guaranteed cheaper than buying them at the theater.

dialogues.speaker: Timothy
dialogues.text: People say there's nothing more beautiful in all of Snezhnograd than Odette's singing. And if you haven't seen Vodyanitsa dance, you may as well not have visited Snezhnograd at all.

dialogues.speaker: Timothy
dialogues.text: Operettas, ballettos, you know, all that fancy stuff — I got the whole lot! Straight from the troupe. Honest business!
